title: SRA-MCTS: Self-driven Reasoning Augmentation with Monte Carlo Tree Search for Code Generation
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时 rollout、选择器、反馈信号和计算预算的读者
one_line: An end-to-end MCTS-to-SFT code-reasoning recipe with official code and a model release.
SRA-MCTS 从中高难 LeetCode 题目出发，在树中生成思考步骤和代码，并把选中路径转换为 question-thinking-code 的 SFT 记录。
why: It illustrates which search-tree fields must be released to audit an MCTS data recipe; the public final records are not a substitute for the missing branch history.
inclusion_reason: It illustrates which search-tree fields must be released to audit an MCTS data recipe; the public final records are not a substitute for the missing branch history.

title: Problem
问题
html: Code models can generate solutions for simple tasks yet struggle when a problem requires decomposition before implementation. SRA-MCTS, published in the IJCAI 2025 Main Track, targets the missing intermediate data object: a natural-language “thinking” path generated before code and reused as an SFT target. It uses Monte Carlo Tree Search to propose, score, reflect on, and select reasoning steps, then asks the same backbone to turn the resulting thinking into code. For the atlas, the central distinction is between the internal search record, with states, actions, self-evaluation rewards, reflections, and rejected branches, and the flattened released question-solution record. Final benchmark execution can score code, but it does not retroactively validate every model-scored reasoning step.

代码模型可以完成简单任务，但当问题需要先分解再实现时往往表现不足。发表于 IJCAI 2025 Main Track 的 SRA-MCTS 针对缺失的中间数据对象：在代码之前生成自然语言“thinking”路径，并将其作为 SFT target 复用。方法使用 Monte Carlo Tree Search 提议、打分、反思和选择推理步骤，再要求同一 backbone 把最终 thinking 转成代码。对本图谱而言，关键区别在于内部搜索记录与扁平化发布记录：前者包含 state、action、自评 reward、reflection 和 rejected branches，后者主要是 question-solution。最终 benchmark 执行可以给代码评分，但不能反向验证每个由模型打分的推理步骤。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: SRA-MCTS represents each node with State, Action, Reward, and Reflection. UCT selects a leaf; expansion samples several non-duplicate next steps; the same LLM evaluates each state-action pair through a progressive rubric and writes a reflection; scores are backpropagated to influence later selection. A reflection can also emit the stopping signal, after which the selected natural-language steps are concatenated as thinking and used to prompt code generation. The final SFT object is a question-thinking-code triple. This is self-driven rather than verifier-driven process supervision: the search value is an LLM judgment, while executable benchmark tests are used for downstream evaluation, not described as the construction reward. Its track relevance is the conversion of a search tree into a training trajectory and the audit gap created when only the selected path is retained.

SRA-MCTS 用 State、Action、Reward 和 Reflection 表示每个节点。UCT 选择叶节点；扩展阶段采样多个不重复的下一步；同一 LLM 通过渐进 rubric 评估每个 state-action pair 并写出 reflection；分数回传后影响后续选择。Reflection 也可输出停止信号，随后被选中的自然语言步骤拼接成 thinking，并用于提示代码生成。最终 SFT 数据对象是 question-thinking-code triple。这里采用的是 self-driven 而非 verifier-driven process supervision：搜索 value 来自 LLM 判断，而可执行 benchmark tests 用于下游评测，论文没有将其描述为构造阶段 reward。该工作的轨道相关性在于把搜索树转换为训练轨迹，也在于只保留选中路径时产生的审计缺口。

title: Method
方法
html:
Training prompts come from medium and hard LeetCode questions. The authors discard source answers and remove training questions that overlap test questions using 10-gram duplicate detection with a 0.3 similarity threshold, leaving 1,819 unique prompts. For each prompt, SRA-MCTS repeats selection, expansion, Evaluation & Reflection, and backpropagation. The reported search uses UCT with exploration constant 0.5, expands three child nodes, retries duplicate steps up to five times, caps the overall search at five iterations, and uses expansion temperature 0.9 with top-p 0.98. The LLM judges single-step correctness, solution coherence, completeness, and overall correctness; Reflection either guides the next iteration or emits an end signal. Backpropagation uses alpha=0.5.

After search, code-like text is removed from thinking with regular expressions. The question and thinking prompt the same model to generate final code, and question, thinking, and code form the SFT record. Experiments use gemma-2-2b-it, Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct; LoRA training via LLaMA-Factory uses learning rate 1e-4, two epochs, warmup ratio 0.05, batch size 4, and two RTX A6000 GPUs. The official repository is Apache-2.0, while the linked BinXD/SRA-MCTS-Llama-3.1-8B dataset is CC-BY-NC-4.0 and displays a final JSON schema with question and solution. Its card and repository claim process data covering reasoning paths and code, but the verified public schema does not expose tree parent IDs, node rewards, reflection fields, visit counts, or rejected branches; completeness at that granularity remains unknown.

训练提示来自 LeetCode 的 medium 与 hard 问题。作者丢弃源答案，并用 10-gram 重复检测和 0.3 相似度阈值删除与测试题重叠的训练问题，最终保留 1,819 个唯一提示。对每个提示，SRA-MCTS 重复 selection、expansion、Evaluation & Reflection 和 backpropagation。论文设置 UCT exploration constant 为 0.5，每次扩展三个子节点，重复步骤最多重试五次，总搜索最多五轮；扩展 temperature 为 0.9、top-p 为 0.98。LLM 依次判断单步正确性、解法连贯性、完整性和整体正确性；Reflection 要么指导下一轮，要么输出结束信号。回传使用 alpha=0.5。

搜索后，用正则表达式从 thinking 中去除代码类文本。Question 与 thinking 再提示同一模型生成最终代码，三者组成 SFT 记录。实验使用 gemma-2-2b-it、Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct；通过 LLaMA-Factory 进行 LoRA 训练，学习率 1e-4、两轮、warmup ratio 0.05、batch size 4，并使用两张 RTX A6000。官方仓库采用 Apache-2.0，而链接的 BinXD/SRA-MCTS-Llama-3.1-8B 数据集采用 CC-BY-NC-4.0，展示的最终 JSON schema 为 question 与 solution。其数据卡和仓库声称 process data 覆盖 reasoning paths 与代码，但已核实公开 schema 没有暴露 tree parent ID、node reward、reflection 字段、visit count 或 rejected branches；这一粒度的完整性仍为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper evaluates on Human-Eval, MBPP, Human-Eval+, and MBPP+, with GPT-4o-derived Full and Complex difficulty splits. It reports improvements for several backbone-dataset combinations, including an approximately 11-point gain on MBPP-Complex for Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, but also reports declines on some Human-Eval-related settings and a seven-point MBPP decline for Qwen2.5-14B relative to external-model distillation. The authors additionally use GPT-4o to label thinking as low, medium, or high quality and observe cases where this judge score disagrees with downstream performance; they note the judge may overvalue unnecessary overthinking. These results support studying self-generated search traces, but neither pass@1 nor an LLM quality label proves that the released reasoning path is correct or that the hidden tree record is complete.

论文在 Human-Eval、MBPP、Human-Eval+ 与 MBPP+ 上评测，并用 GPT-4o 构造 Full 与 Complex 难度 split。论文报告多个 backbone-data 组合有所提升，其中 Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 在 MBPP-Complex 上约提升 11 点；同时也报告若干 Human-Eval 相关设置下降，以及 Qwen2.5-14B 相对外部模型蒸馏在 MBPP 上下降 7 点。作者还用 GPT-4o 将 thinking 标为 low、medium 或 high quality，并观察到 judge 分数与下游性能不一致的情况；论文指出 judge 可能高估不必要的 overthinking。这些结果支持研究自生成搜索轨迹，但 pass@1 与 LLM 质量标签都不能证明发布的推理路径正确，也不能证明未展示的搜索树记录完整。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior CoT augmentation samples a linear explanation, and Tree-of-Thought explores alternatives without necessarily turning the selected reasoning into training data. ReST-MCTS-style work searches complete answers or uses a separate process reward model. SRA-MCTS instead applies MCTS specifically to the pre-code natural-language thinking portion, asks the same backbone to generate and evaluate steps, carries a reflection field into subsequent expansion, and then serializes the selected thinking with code for SFT. The direction signal is the explicit intermediate object linking question decomposition to code generation. MCTS, UCT, reflection, self-training, and SFT are not new components, and the method does not establish that self-evaluation is calibrated or that the chosen natural-language plan caused the code to pass tests.

既有 CoT augmentation 通常采样线性解释，Tree-of-Thought 虽探索替代路径，却不一定把选中推理转成训练数据。ReST-MCTS 类工作搜索完整答案，或使用独立 process reward model。SRA-MCTS 改为把 MCTS 专门用于代码之前的自然语言 thinking 部分，让同一 backbone 生成并评估步骤，把 reflection 字段带入后续扩展，再将选中 thinking 与代码序列化为 SFT 数据。其方向信号是把问题分解连接到代码生成的显式中间对象。MCTS、UCT、reflection、self-training 与 SFT 都不是新组件；该方法也没有证明 self-evaluation 已校准，或选中的自然语言计划因果性地促成代码通过测试。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The construction reward is produced by the same LLM family that generates steps, so correlated errors can reinforce a plausible but wrong branch. The stop signal is also model-generated, and a five-iteration cap can truncate unresolved reasoning. Regular-expression removal can delete useful code-like evidence or leave leakage. The final code is not described as being execution-filtered before entering SFT, and the released example itself may contain incorrect code; benchmark tests therefore should not be treated as training-time verification. The 10-gram overlap check covers named test sets but does not establish broader LeetCode contamination control. The public final schema collapses the path and code into solution text, while raw branch lineage and reward calibration are not established. Repository and dataset licenses differ, and downstream users must preserve the non-commercial dataset restriction. Benchmark gains and GPT-4o judgments are not data-quality proof.

构造 reward 由生成步骤的同一 LLM family 给出，因此相关错误可能强化看似合理但错误的分支。停止信号同样由模型生成，五轮上限可能截断未解决推理。正则去除可能删掉有用的代码类证据，也可能残留泄漏。论文没有说明最终代码在进入 SFT 前经过执行过滤，发布示例本身也可能包含错误代码；因此不能把 benchmark tests 当作训练时验证。10-gram 重叠检查覆盖所列测试集，但不能建立更广泛的 LeetCode 污染控制。公开最终 schema 将路径与代码折叠进 solution 文本，原始分支血缘与 reward 校准未得到确认。仓库与数据集许可证不同，下游必须保留数据集的非商业限制。Benchmark 提升与 GPT-4o 判断都不是数据质量证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For the rollout/search/test-time-trace track, SRA-MCTS is useful as a compact MCTS-to-SFT recipe for code reasoning and as a negative example of what is lost by flattening a tree. A reusable record should keep the LeetCode source and revision, overlap decision, model and decoding settings, node and parent IDs, state, action, raw self-score, rubric decision, reflection, visit count, UCT value, backpropagated reward, stopping reason, all rejected siblings, the selected thinking, regex transformation log, generated code, execution environment, tests, and terminal result. This would support process-supervision research, search-policy audits, SFT, and comparisons between model judgment and executable correctness without conflating them.

对 rollout/search/test-time-trace 轨道而言，SRA-MCTS 既是一个紧凑的代码推理 MCTS-to-SFT 配方，也是展示树被扁平化后损失何种信息的反例。可复用记录应保留 LeetCode 来源与 revision、重叠判定、模型与解码设置、node 与 parent ID、state、action、原始 self-score、rubric decision、reflection、visit count、UCT value、回传 reward、停止原因、全部 rejected siblings、选中 thinking、正则变换日志、生成代码、执行环境、tests 与终局结果。这样可支持 process-supervision 研究、搜索策略审计、SFT，以及模型判断与可执行正确性的比较，同时避免将二者混为一谈。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• The training pool contains 1,819 medium/hard LeetCode prompts after a 10-gram overlap filter against the named test sets; broader contamination control remains unknown.
  • Search nodes store State, Action, Reward, and Reflection; rewards come from LLM self-evaluation.
  • The reported search expands three children and stops after an end signal or five iterations.
  • The public dataset uses a question-solution schema and a CC-BY-NC-4.0 label; the code repository is Apache-2.0.
  • Pass@1 and GPT-4o quality judgments do not validate intermediate search steps.

• 训练池包含 1,819 个 medium/hard LeetCode prompts；它们经过针对指定测试集的 10-gram 重叠过滤，但更广范围的污染控制仍为 unknown。
  • 搜索节点存储 State、Action、Reward 与 Reflection；reward 来自 LLM self-evaluation。
  • 论文设置每次扩展三个子节点，并在结束信号或五轮后停止。
  • 公开数据采用 question-solution schema 与 CC-BY-NC-4.0 标记；代码仓库为 Apache-2.0。
  • Pass@1 与 GPT-4o 质量判断不能验证中间搜索步骤。
